verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires routing AXP2101 VBACKUP pin 27 to an accessible test pad or via for optional backup-power attachment.
The client adds implementation-relevant placement and population constraints: expose VBACKUP beside PWROK without populating a backup component.
This is a target-specific implementation claim reporting that VBACKUP was exposed through an added 2.54 mm header; it is not runtime verification.
